note: Canonical unbreakable-law registry — the machine map from each AGENTS.md law to its enforcement. AGENTS.md (prose) stays the LAW SoT; this file is the derived enforcement map (anchored by agents_md rule number). 'tier': enforced = a machine enforcer exists; advisory = declared NON-NEGOTIABLE in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md but has NO static enforcer yet (honest — not faked). 'moment' = where the FULL rule is enforced live RIGHT NOW: write-time-hook (blocks per Edit/Write), local-gate-script (must be run on demand — e.g. node tooling/enforcers/*.mjs), dormant-ci (wired in .github/workflows/ci.yml but Actions are account-suppressed — see ci-trigger-blocker), none (advisory). Verified fail-closed by tooling/coherence LAW-* checks (import the canonical rule lib and assert membership + downgrade-ratchet) plus each enforcer's own tests.

laws.note: full pattern also enforced by the write-time hook and dormant-ci law-lint

laws.statement: Zero console.* — use the pino structured logger with X-Heady-Trace-Id
laws.note: hook v1.1.0 sources the canonical rule (full console.*) at write-time; also local-gate/dormant-ci
hook v1.1.0 sources the full canonical GLASSBOX_LINE_RULES at write-time

laws.statement: Zero localhost / 127.0.0.1 / 0.0.0.0 / ::1 / hardcoded-port — URLs from env
laws.note: hook v1.1.0 sources the full canonical LOCALHOST_RULES at write-time

laws.statement: Zod validation on all API inputs; no unvalidated data crosses a boundary
laws.note: Enforced slice: any apps/packages source reading req.body / request.json() must import its validator from @heady/contracts (the strict dependency-free shape authority) or zod. Zod itself derives via OpenAPI codegen later (ADR-0002) — until then the contracts validators realize the shapes (task-shapes/mcp-shapes/facts-schema idiom).

laws.statement: HEADY_BRAND header in all new files

laws.note: NO enforcer — cache layer not wired (pre-launch). Activate a key-literal check when the Upstash/KV client lands (Phase 2/3).

laws.statement: φ-derived constants; zero magic numbers (from phi-math)
laws.note: Enforced slice: no bare numeric ms literal as a setTimeout/setInterval delay in apps/packages sources — timing derives from packages/phi-math (the constant SoT). Broader magic-number detection stays review-enforced (high false-positive).

laws.statement: Tests alongside code (Vitest unit, Playwright E2E, k6 load)
laws.note: Enforced for every packages/ + tooling/ workspace member (coherence TEST-missing, exit 2); apps without tests surface as INFO debt (TEST-missing-app) until their Phase-3 build-out.

laws.statement: Error handling everywhere — no empty catch, no swallowed promise
File-content embedding indexing via Merkle-tree hashing, never Postgres CDC (scoped: DB→derived-store sync uses WAL CDC per ADR-0014)
laws.note: Advisory pending the heady-merkle-index build. The apparent CDC conflict is RESOLVED (ADR-0023 §Reconciliation v2 + compendium R11, founder-approved 2026-07-23): Merkle hashing triggers file/source re-embeds; WAL CDC (ADR-0014) syncs derived stores from the database SoR — two triggers, two sources. Add a static trigger-path check when tooling/embed-corpus grows its Merkle trigger.

laws.statement: No secrets committed to source control
No dropped store (Qdrant) as an active dependency; Neon/pgvector is the authority
Patent-locked files (HS-2026-051..062) require CODEOWNERS/ARBITER review before modification
laws.note: governance-gate verifies every patent-marked file is CODEOWNERS-covered; PR-blocking needs Actions (suppressed) or founder review.

laws.statement: No Vue/Angular; React only for complex canvas components
laws.note: Enforced: coherence C-framework fails on any vue/@vue/angular/@angular dependency in any workspace manifest. React's complex-canvas-only scoping stays review-enforced.

laws.statement: colab/ is quarantined (throwaway batch/experiment only — 1536-dim embeddings, gateway bypass, plaintext-secret history); the rebuild (packages/apps/tooling) must never import from it

known_defects.statement: The write-time hook carried its own WEAKER copy of the console/placeholder/localhost patterns (policy fork vs canonical tooling/enforcers/lib/rules.mjs): console.log only vs all console.*, 3 placeholder tokens vs 6, 2 localhost patterns vs 5.
known_defects.fix: hook v1.1.0 sources the canonical GLASSBOX_LINE_RULES + LOCALHOST_RULES via await import() with an inline fallback (degrades to prior behavior on load failure, never bricks the edit path). Verified: console.warn/XXX/0.0.0.0/::1 now blocked at write-time; clean input passes.

known_defects.statement: The hook enforced the canonical RULES but not the canonical per-line heady-allow waiver contract — sanctioned waivers (honored by every gate script) were unauthorable through Edit/Write (the second half of the policy fork).
known_defects.fix: hook v1.2.0 (founder-approved 2026-07-23) scans line-by-line and honors exactly each gate script's waiver semantics: glass-box (family|ruleId), no-localhost (family token only), ESM/brand none — tested against the same trimmed 200-char evidence window the enforcers use. Proven with 8 payload cases including wrong-token, ESM-waiver-attempt, and beyond-window refusals (all still blocked).
